# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster enchants a melee weapon which is to become his ''Warrior's Weapon''.
This spell grants the weapon a +5 magic bonus. Anyone other than the caster
who attempts to utilize Ihis weapon will receive a penalty to its use equal to
the bonus it gives the caster.
@@ 2
Causes the warrior's weapon to glow with light. This light may be varied by
the caster from as bright as a torch to as dim as a candle.
@@ 3
Caster's warrior weapon is charged with electrical energy for the duration of
this spell. Whenever the caster gets a critical result with the weapon it does
an additional 'A' Electricity critical. Alternatively, throughout the duration
of this spell, the caster may elect to shoot this electncal energy in the form
of a shock bolt with a maximum range of 50' (which immedialely ends this
spell). The caster may develop skill in shooting this bolt.
@@ 4
Caster may throw his weapon for the duration with a maximum range equal to his
strength bonus x10 in feet (with a minimum of 30'). The weapon attacks on its
normal table with the following modifications: up to one tenth maximum range
+10 up to quarter maximum range +0 up to half maximum range -40 up to maximum
range -70.
@@ 5
Caster may store one spell on his weapon. No other spell may be cast while one
is stored. Tbis spell costs the same amount of PPs as the spell to be stored.
@@ 6
As Blade I, except warrior's weapon becomes a +10 magic weapon.
@@ 7
Caster is able to repair any damage to his weapon. Caster is able to rejoin a
broken portion of up to 1 linear inch per level.
@@ 8
As Jolting Blade, except can inflict up to an 'A' Heat Critical. The caster
may to throw a firebolt with a maximum range of 100'.
@@ 9
Caster's weapon will fly through the air to return to the caster's hand at the
rate of 100' per round. If the weapon is restrained it cannot break free, but
if someone holding it they must make a hard strength maneuver to not lose his
giip on the weapon.
@@ 10
Caster is able to use his full weapon OB as a parry against missile attacks
for the duration this spell.
@@ 11
As Blade I, except warrior's weapon becomes a +15 magic weapon.
@@ 12
Caster ''absorbs'' one warrior weapon, and reproduces it at need (by recasting
this spell each time the weapon is shealhed or unsheathed). The mass and
weight of the weapon are added to the caster's mass while the weapon is
sheathed.
@@ 14
As Return Blade, except weapon returns to caster' s hand, via teleport, from
any place, up to 1 mile away per level of caster.
@@ 15
Caster causes his weapon to build up concussive energy. If the next strike
made with the weapon results in a critical, an extra Impact critical of one
less seventy is inflicted (treat an 'A' critical as an 'A' critical -25).
@@ 16
Caster's next successful strike against any enchanted item, weapon, etc,
causes the item to make an RR versus the caster's level (with a special
modification of -20) or embedded spells are dispelled.
@@ 17
As Blade I, except warrior's weapon becomes a +20 magic weapon.
@@ 18
As Jolting Blade, except can inflict up to a 'C' Electricity critical. The
caster may elect to throw a lightning bolt with a maximum range of 150'.
@@ 19
Causes caster's weapon to be a ''Cleaving'' weapon. When a foe's weapon
successfully parries its attack, the defending weapon must check for breakage.
The strength of the caster's weapon is subtracted from the foe's breakage
check.
@@ 20
Caster causes his weapon's next attack to be made on the attack table of the
caster's choice.
@@ 25
If caster's next attack this round inflicts a critical, it does an additional
'E' critical of the caster's choice.
@@ 30
Caster's weapon will ''dance'' for the duration of this spell. The caster must
fight with the weapon one round prior to letting the weapon ''dance''. The
weapon will have an OB of half the caster's normal OB. It has an AT of 20, a
DB of +0, and can take 5 hits per level of the caster (before spell is
dispelled). Once this spell is cast, the sword will not stop attacking until
it is dispelled or the duration ends.
@@ 50
Caster may roll any criticals he inflicts with his Warrior Weapon this round
on the Slaying column of the Large Creature Critical Strike Table. If the
target is Super Large, the caster rolls on the Slaying column ofthe Super
Large Critical Strike Table.
